rows: What is Prussian blue's color mechanism?
Intervalence charge transfer: Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺ through cyanide bridges — not d-d transition
Why does Prussian blue treat nuclear accidents?
Open crystal lattice absorbs Cs⁺ and Tl⁺ by ion exchange — FDA approved for Cs-137 and thallium poisoning
Why are Van Gogh's Sunflowers darkening?
Chrome yellow (PbCrO₄) photoreduction: Cr⁶⁺ → Cr³⁺ under UV + sulfur compounds → green/brown products form
Copper arsenite (CuHAsO₃) — brilliant green from 1778, extremely toxic (arsenic), widely used in wallpapers/food
Copper acetoarsenite — even more toxic arsenic green, also used as insecticide for Colorado potato beetle
Hydrated chromium(III) oxide — safe, stable, transparent blue-green; replaced arsenic greens
What compounds did the coal tar / dye industry spawn?
BASF, Bayer, Hoechst — synthetic dye chemistry scaled to industrial → then pharmaceutical industry
Prussian blue, introduced to Japan via Dutch traders; enabled the characteristic depth of Hokusai's print
